data.name: TTKillerPlus
data.subtitle: TikTok with downloads, no ads and region switch
data.localizedDescription: TTKillerPlus is a modified TikTok by iKarwan. Download videos from the feed, stories and Explore, save photos and profile avatars, merge post photos with their music, block promoted posts and ads, toggle seen/unseen, hide tabs, browse the feed of a specific country, show country flags and post dates, and auto-like in live streams. iPadOS supported.
data.versionDescription:
TikTok 47.4.0 | TikTok_47.4_TTKillerPlus_2.3

• Fixes injection for jailbreaks may not be injected due to bundle iD missing
- Add country flag to the profile page to know the creator origin country
- Add follow status to new profile style user name
- Add v46.7+ compatibility.
- Fix like confirmation bypass on double tap.
- Fix post date display format.
- Fix flag button not tappable.
- Other fixes & improvements.
- Update base IPA to TikTok v47.4
